title: 5 new things in your app!
intro: From Mom's big review: your solo is the plan, your music and videos are one tap away, and Monday is a watching day. Tap 👀 Show me how for the steps, or ▶ Try it to jump straight in.

items.pitch: A game keeps your streak. Your solo makes the plan done.
steps: Look at the chips at the top of Today: “⭐ Plan done” or “✓ Streak safe · solo next”.
Any bite keeps your streak. Only your solo (or the memory run) makes the plan done.
Plan done = your pet grows and the reminder stays quiet.
Tap “▶ Start practice”: the solo part of the list is the one that counts.

items.pitch: Three classes on Monday, so no dancing at home: watch Hannah, then picture the solo in the car.
steps: On Monday, Today says “watch Hannah's videos”.
Tap “▶ Watch + picture”: the walkthrough, the run-through, then eyes closed in the car.
Tuesday is the 15-minute memory run again.

items.pitch: Your solo's music, the trio's music and the videos are right under each practice item, and on Today.
steps: On Today, tap “🎵 Solo”, “🎵 Trio” or “📹 Videos”.
In practice, each solo or trio item has its own buttons: the music, “🧩 Chunks”, “⏸ Pause & Predict”.
The clock waits while the music plays. Tap “▶ Go” when you're back.

items.pitch: The timer doesn't tick things off for you any more.
steps: Practice is Timed from the start: each item has its own clock.
When it rings, tap “✅ Did it” or “↻ Again”.
Tap 🔊 and the bunny reads each item out loud.

items.pitch: On a home day, the solo comes first; the games open when the plan is done.
steps: On Thursday, Friday and Sunday, Play says “🏠 Home day: the solo first”.
What's Next?, Dance Along and Count Along are always there: they are solo work.
Trick Quest comes back Nov 9, once the solo is memorized.
